verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents an `agent` primitive that turns high-level tasks into fully autonomous browser workflows, with configurable model, instructions and max steps (stagehand-docs-28). It also supports caching agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts (stagehand-docs-29), agent fallback when a single action becomes a multi-step flow (stagehand-docs-30), and plain-English commands such as "fill out the contact form" (stagehand-docs-31, stagehand-docs-16). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end multi-step agent runs, agent documentation in the current v4 docs (the evidence is from v3), and detail on how navigation and form-filling behave across flows.
